verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas lists REST API access as a plan feature, so the axis applies. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt docs, the Editor API reference and the MCP server are adjacent features and do not count as an OpenAPI-equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
